package service

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for service_method_accepts_gin_context: Service methods that take `*gin.Context` instead of domain inputs plus `context.Context`.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type DashboardService struct {
	stats StatsRepository
}

func (s *DashboardService) GetUser(c *gin.Context) {
	userID := c.Param("userID")
	if userID == "" {
		c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": "userID required"})
		return
	}
	data, err := s.stats.FetchMetrics(c.Request.Context(), userID)
	if err != nil {
		c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{"error": err.Error()})
		return
	}
	c.JSON(http.StatusOK, data)
}

type StatsRepository interface {
	FetchMetrics(ctx interface{ Context() }, userID string) (interface{}, error)
}
